description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rm' command with the '--pathspec-from-file' option. It sets up test scenarios, verifies outcomes, and checks for error conditions related to removing files based on path specifications provided via a file.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to the checkpoint tag, restoring the working directory to a known state.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Checks that the current status of the specific files matches the expected output.

calls: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
git add fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
